title: Combine PRs #3259, #3269 and #3210 into one combined PR: one push run instead of three
why: Three reviewed PRs merging separately start three push runs; one combined PR starts one, and it proves the combined-PR recipe on real lanes.
source: Coordinator 18:16 CST Nov 13: lane combine-first-three started (session_013NEJKyubnYbVk1PhBXyFYX, Sonnet medium), tagged to step combined-pr-recipe.
note: Filed 18:16 CST Nov 13. The lane builds one combined PR of #3259 (role hand-off wording), #3269 and #3210, each already reviewed under its own rules; ruling own-767-a-combined-pr allows a PR to merge alone and to combine reviewed lanes when that saves CI. Done check: one PR with each lane's own commit kept, lane lint read, and a green PR run that ran its suites (not an all-skipped run; step force-advice-needs-real-run). The first member #3259 had a lane lint UNKNOWN on a queued macOS job (page item 775); the lane reads that first. Relations: combined-pr-recipe, express-combined-pr, lane-lint-unknown-on-ready-pr. Past rulings checked: own-767-a-combined-pr. Merge needs the owner's word or a repo grant; the batch runner marks ready. Open question 18:18 CST Nov 13 (lane combine-first-three, PR #3301, 18:18): decision pr-review-record line 7 says "Each PR carries a review record", so combined PR #3301 needs one, but the recipe (step combined-pr-recipe: "lane lint, ready, its own record") does not say WHO reviews it (a fresh reviewer on the combined diff, or the members' records stand) or whether a fix verifier applies. Triage has not read pr-review-record. Routed to the coordinator, who answers; the lane waits and posts nothing. If the answer adds a record rule it changes a rule, so an owner item follows. Precedent: #3278 (step express-combined-pr) merged as a combined PR; how its record read is unchecked by triage.
